meta.name: SOS Apollo — Harm Control Runtime
meta.notes: Single source of truth. Every ID used anywhere in code, locale or tests must be declared here. Changing this file requires: npm run registry:check (codegen + lint) and clinical review for any rule/card touching P0 or P1.

rules: IDs are append-only. Never reuse a retired ID; mark it deprecated instead.
Numeric suffixes leave gaps of 10 in policy tables so rules can be inserted without renumbering.
Predicates are data (JSON DSL), never code. The explanation log is generated from the same predicate tree, so logic and 'why' can never drift apart.
Every card copy lives in registry/locales/<locale>.json and carries a review status.
Retired IDs stay listed in conventions.retiredIds and are never reused.

laws.text: Event is fact. The app only records what it actually observed (a tap is a tap, not a completed call).
State is temporary. Explicit event beats TTL; TTL beats stale data.
Escalate fast, de-escalate slow. Time never lowers severity; only explicit events do.
Hard rules beat everything. One P0 has exactly one commander (first matching rule wins).
P0 does not optimize, it executes. Nothing is asked before the emergency action.
Silence raises uncertainty; it never invents a symptom. Background is not silence.
One foreground action, N background effects. The higher the criticality, the smaller the interface.
Ask only what can change what happens next (value of information).
'Não consigo' invalidates the strategy, never the person.
Actor defines perspective, never identity. No login, no names, no phone numbers stored.
Emergency access does not depend on JavaScript staying alive. The app fails to the shell.
The real world beats the app. Nothing (captcha, network, onboarding) ever gates help.
Remote continuity can enrich decisions but never be required. The acute plane decides alone, offline, first.
Historical information may influence; it may never become current fact. A prior reorders, it never sets a signal.
Derived interpretations are never presented as user-reported facts. Reported and derived stay separate everywhere.
No diagnosis is inferred from operational patterns. The system stores recurrence; professionals diagnose.
Sensitive history is not analytics. Health state never reaches operational logs or telemetry.
Sharing is scoped, expiring and auditable, and always initiated by the person or the current helper.
Emergency access never depends on network or backend.
Memory exists to reduce burden, not to increase surveillance.
Help comes before questions. Once help has started, at most one question stands between two helps.
Never interrupt help to ask how the person is. Silence brings presence, not a question; the person says how they are when they want to.
A way out and a menu, always: every non-emergency screen offers other techniques and a person to reach, beside the 192 that never leaves the screen.
The same question is not repeated within its interval, and 'I'd rather just continue' is always an answer.
Pace is read, never reported: how long a person takes to answer may make the app ask less and offer simpler things first. It never becomes anxiety, never raises a band and never diagnoses (L15, L16).

What was used only adds care. Substances and combinations are asked directly (one tap may answer two things, e.g. «Bala + álcool»), one question between two helps, and help never waits for them. A dangerous combination raises attention (band), never P0 by itself; the app never suggests a dose, a second substance or an 'antidote'.

Breathing is the background, not a step: a slow orb paces the breath behind every non-P0 card while breathing is normal and the person responds. It never takes a card's place, never gates anything and disappears in P0.

Only the person moves the screen. A timer, an answer ageing out, a follow-up falling due or returning to the app never replaces a card, question or help; it waits for the next tap. The one exception is an emergency (P0). A question may be thought about for as long as the person needs.

bands.meaning: Possible immediate emergency. Bypass everything. Execute.
Safety or company must be stabilized first.

signals.doc: Who is holding the phone. Perspective only.
Fainting reported (text trigger). Proposed; clinical review.
Self-harm intent reported (text trigger). Proposed; clinical review.
Asked ONCE (Q_ANXIETY maxAsks 1, audit 011), so the answer lasts an hour; after that the person's own reports (menu) and the derived pace carry the session (L25).
Operational context only. Never inferred from symptoms. Never exported.
Which one, when the person says so (Akinator follow-up of substanceClass). Operational context only. Explicit answer only, never inferred from symptoms or text. Never exported.
Alcohol on top of something else (combination rules). Operational context only. Explicit answer only, never inferred from symptoms or text. Never exported.
Erection pill (sildenafil/tadalafil) and/or poppers, for the combination rules. Operational context only. Explicit answer only, never inferred from symptoms or text. Never exported.
What bothers the body most right now, as the person says it (question or body chip). Picks a care tip; never a diagnosis.
Explicit report of how the person in care is doing (self or helper perspective).

invalidation.doc: Explicit arrival replaces 'alone' immediately (no waiting for TTL).
If the person says they are alone again, the companion left.
A helper is, by definition, with the person.
Feeling worse makes the last anxiety level stale.

events.doc: Boot. Creates an anonymous, local-only session.
Answer or action that sets signals. Carries source.
An action made a signal stale on purpose (e.g. after grounding, re-check anxiety).
The person picked a technique or a contact from the menu (L23). Shown next if still eligible; its outcome clears it.
Something the runtime must not forget (friend coming, relocation...).
User tapped a tel:/sms:/wa.me link. The app knows the tap, not the outcome (L01).
User says 'Já liguei'. Distinct from HANDOFF_OPENED: a report, not an observed tap (L01).
Professional help arrived. Only way (besides CORRECTION) to leave the P0 latch.
'Me enganei'. Clears the P0 latch and resets the commander's signals to unknown (so they are re-asked).
A negated text trigger asks for explicit confirmation instead of acting.
Free text matched no local trigger. No generative reply exists.
Delete everything on this device now.
online/offline. Only affects strategies that require network.
Wake-up hint at nextWakeAt. Carries no meaning by itself; the core evaluates deadlines.

textTriggers.doc: Free text is NOT chat. It is an alternate input for critical local triggers only. Affirmative match → act (over-triggering costs one tap to correct; under-triggering can cost a life). Negated match → ask explicitly.

hardRules.name: medical_risk_then_silence
hardRules.doc: Known acute medical risk + repeated silence while the screen was visible. Silence alone never reaches P0 (L06).

hardRules.name: user_called_emergency
hardRules.doc: The user tapped 192 on their own (shell or card). The real world wins (L12): the engine follows them into P0 'waiting' guidance.

risk.doc: Ordinal 0..4 per dimension. Level = MAX of matching rows (monotone, no weights, no fake precision). 'impairment' is computed and logged but no band rule reads it in v1 (BR-P1-02 was removed: shadowed by BR-P1-01, found by the coverage gate). 'mixing' (audit 011) is the combination of what the person said they used: 3 = depressants together (alcohol with G, a sedative pill or ket) or poppers with an erection pill; 2 = alcohol with a stimulant (coke, MD or unknown), or a stimulant with an erection pill or poppers.

bandRules.doc: Not sticky: resolving uncertainty with explicit answers may lower the band immediately (L02).
A dangerous combination the person told us about (L26): full attention, never P0 by itself.

hysteresis.doc: Upgrades are immediate. Leaving a sticky band requires an EXPLICIT human input in that step (time alone never de-escalates, L03) AND (minDwellSec elapsed OR trend=improving). Non-sticky bands (uncertainty) follow the facts immediately.

requirements.doc: Preconditions a strategy may declare. Data, not code. 'awake' (audit 011): standing in a shower is only offered when the person is responsive, breathes normally and nothing sedating was said (no downer, G, sedative pill, ket, alcohol-only or dangerous mix). 'can_swallow' (audit 011): nothing by mouth (water, food, gargle, toothbrush) unless the person responds AND breathes normally.

pace.doc: L25. Only the time to answer a QUESTION counts (visible time), never the time spent on an exercise. pace = slow when the last minSamples answers each took ≥ slowSec (90 s since audit 012: thinking before answering is normal, only real struggle counts); quick when each took ≤ quickSec; samples older than windowSec are forgotten. A slow pace means no question between two helps and simpler techniques first (deferWhen); nothing else.

ambient.doc: L27. Output.breath: the orb behind the card. Pattern from studies/002 (breath_46): in 4, hold 1, out 6. Shown only when 'when' holds and the band is not P0.

silence.doc: Silence = a response-awaiting card stayed VISIBLE for afterSec with no human input. Hidden time never counts (L06).

skills.doc: Generic assessment. Which question to ask is decided by the VOI engine (Akinator logic), never by a hardcoded flow.
The only P0 skill. Phases are derived from state, never chosen by policy.
L10: a helper is by definition with the person, even after company's TTL expires (Q_COMPANY is self-only), so a helper always keeps stay_close and never gets the self-crisis message templates.
Generalizes 'confirm_arrival': any due commitment is confirmed with its own card (commitments[].confirmCard).

strategies.doc: Retired (audit 011, owner decision): paced breathing is no longer a step that takes a card's place. It is the ambient orb behind every non-P0 card (ambient.breath, L27). Kept so the ID is never reused.

skills.doc: Contraindications are data (INV-027): anything that paces or changes breathing (breath_pacer, double_sigh, humming) and the cold-water shock (cold_water) needs breathing=normal and responsiveness=responsive; five_senses needs responsiveness=responsive; feet_floor and press_wall are the simple fallbacks. 'Não tenho água aqui' blocks cold_water for an hour (L09). L25: breath_pacer and five_senses move to the end of the order while pace = slow (they ask more of a tired mind); nothing is excluded. breath_pacer is retired (audit 011): breathing lives in the ambient orb (L27). Rotates (least shown first) so every option gets its turn before one repeats.

Audit 011 (L26): what the person said they MIXED, each warning once the combination is known, before anything else that is not P0 or a critical question. Never alternates, never waits; once shown it rests for 30 min (cooldown). No dose, no second substance, no antidote (INV-030).

Practical care (audit 011), in order: heat, what bothers the BODY, the SUBSTANCE itself, then everyday care anyone can do. Alternates with grounding through help.last, so the loop never ends and never repeats a tip inside its cooldown. No dose, no volume, no second substance, no antidote (L26, INV-030). Anything that needs swallowing needs a responsive person; the shower needs 'awake'. Rotates (least shown first) so every option gets its turn before one repeats. Combination warnings live in their own skill ('combination') so they never wait behind the alternation.
Stable-state support + the universal fallback 'hold' strategy that guarantees the decision function is total.

strategies.doc: Retired (audit 012, owner): «Tá mais tranquilo. Umas dicas curtas» assumed calm and offered «Me chama em 10 min». Replaced by the care loop, which knows what was used.

cards.doc: Rendered only if an invariant is violated at runtime. Fail-safe, never fail-silent.

invariants.text: band = P0 ⇒ skill = emergency_escalation (one commander).
Every decision yields exactly one foreground card.
The emergency affordance (tel:192) exists on every screen, outside the engine loop.
companion = arrived ⇒ company ≠ alone.
A blocked strategy ('Não consigo') is never selected while blocked.
physicallyUnsafe = yes ⇒ no strategy that requires movement or a safe location.
Latched critical values never expire by TTL; only CORRECTION or HELP_ON_SCENE leave P0.
Card actions/answers/characters respect the engagement budget of the band.
No question is asked more than maxAsks, nor re-asked inside its cooldown after 'Não sei'.
decide() is total: every reachable abstract state yields a valid decision.
decide() is deterministic: same state + same time ⇒ same decision.
substanceClass only ever comes from an explicit user answer.
Silence is only counted while the page was visible for the whole window.
Education content only in bands where engagement.education = true.
A stale card tap is rejected — except an emergency handoff, which is always honored.
src/core imports nothing from runtime/ui and performs no I/O (no fetch, no Date.now, no DOM).
P0 never asks a question before showing the emergency action.
Every band's policy table ends in an always-eligible rule (totality by construction).
Continuity never gates: the card is decided and rendered before any journal or sync work; a sync failure changes no output.
Priors never write a signal. History never becomes a current fact.
Historical preference < current contraindication: a prior can only reorder strategies that are already eligible; fallbacks stay last.
Every journal event and every summary line carries provenance; reported and derived are never merged.
No diagnostic vocabulary in any generated summary (continuity.forbiddenInference).
The journal is append-only and idempotent by eventId; corrections are events; clientSeq is strictly increasing.
Health state never reaches operational logs (single logger with an allowlist).
A share capsule is scoped, expires, is revocable, and its key lives only in the URL fragment.
Grounding respects physiology: breath_pacer is never selected unless breathing=normal and responsiveness=responsive; five_senses never unless responsiveness=responsive.
No policy asks a question because of silence (L22): silence on a help card only adds the PRESENCE notice; HR-008 keeps watching silence when there is medical risk.
The menu (chips) is empty in P0, and a technique picked from it never displaces P0, a critical question, a contraindication or a perspective rule (L23).
No care copy gives a dose, a volume, a second substance to 'come down' or an 'antidote' (L26).
A follow-up question is never asked while its condition (when) is false, and the pace of answers never raises a band or sets a reported signal (L25).
The ambient breathing orb is never shown in P0, nor unless breathing = normal and responsiveness = responsive (L27, INV-027).
A step without human input never changes the card on screen (same instance, taps stay valid) unless the new band is P0 (L28).

storage.doc: Free text is matched locally and discarded; only the trigger id is logged.

v1.reason: v1 has no server endpoint that can be abused: all handoffs are native links (tel:, sms:, wa.me). A captcha before help would break L12.
edge: static hosting behind a CDN (absorbs volumetric attacks)
CSP: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' (no third-party endpoint exists to exfiltrate to)
no third-party scripts, no analytics, no fonts from CDNs
v1.humanSteps: Grounding micro-games (breath_pacer) are calming interactions, never gates.

v2.gate: turnstile_invisible + proof_of_work + per-IP/per-device rate limits + country allowlist for SMS
v2.doc: Only server effects that cost money or reach third parties are gated, and only outside P0/P1.

continuity.doc: v0.2 continuity plane. Everything here is derived from StepResult after the card is decided (L13, INV-019).

journalKinds.doc: Boot of an anonymous session (episodeId = sessionId).
One signal value set by an explicit answer, a text trigger (id only) or a derived rule. Carries provenance.
A signal became unknown by TTL or on purpose.
Derived: band transition, with the commanding hard rule when P0.
done / failed / declined reported by a tap.
An observed tap on tel/sms/whatsapp. Never a claim of delivery (L01).
'Me enganei': reverses a latched fact. Stays in the journal (INV-024).
A negated text trigger forced a question (trigger id only).
Free text matched nothing. The text is never stored.

retention.doc: Days. 0 = never stored. 'episode' = purged with the episode. See docs/privacy/DATA-CLASSIFICATION.md.

buckets.doc: Recency buckets for influence, in days. Discrete, no weights (B2).

evidence.doc: A pattern needs repetition before it may influence (INV-021).

share.doc: Scopes a capsule may carry per audience. LOCATION_CURRENT only when explicitly chosen at share time (D16).

consent.doc: One-time calm choices, never asked in P0/P1 (L12, L20).

forbiddenInference.doc: Terms that a generated summary or a continuity card must never contain (L16, INV-023). Lowercase, accent-insensitive match.
